items.title: Bitcoin faces US CPI test as analysts warn inflation relief may not be enough
items.excerpt: BTC trades near $74,750 ahead of October CPI; analysts say lasting recovery needs spot Bitcoin ETF inflows, with $73,000 as key support.

items.title: Bitcoin miner MARA sold 13,597 BTC for $1.1 billion in six weeks, plans to sell more
items.excerpt: MARA sold 40% of its BTC holdings at about $81K, repaid $750M of Bitcoin-backed loans and will keep selling to fund AI infrastructure.

items.title: Bitcoin holds near $75,000 after flash crash as spot ETF outflows persist
items.excerpt: US spot Bitcoin ETFs saw about $1.28B of outflows over five sessions as BTC logged a fifth straight weekly decline.

items.title: Binance's Bitcoin mining pool finds just one block in a week as shutdown nears
